purpose: Executable browser-first evidence journeys for the unpacked Cockpit Space feedback extension.

safety.session: Create a unique disposable Herdr/browser session name for this run; never use default.
safety.profile: Create a unique isolated Chrome profile and unpack the extension from the current checkout.
safety.tabs: Use only fixture tabs created by this workflow; do not navigate or capture unrelated user tabs.

pages: project-a fixture with changed and untracked files
project-b fixture with changed and untracked files
fixture.documentIdentity: Record tab id, URL, title and content document_id before every mutation and after navigation/reload.

proofContract.screenshots: Every matrix cell captures the actual extension surface in both viewports. Label whether pixels show page overlay, extension popup, captured image, or Cockpit rendering; browser chrome is not evidence.
proofContract.machine: Every matrix cell retains event log, tab/url/document_id, extension/runtime responses, storage snapshot, and relevant network/dispatch receipt.
proofContract.retryEscalation: Retry the named action once after restoring the stated precondition. On a second failure retain console/network/storage diagnostics and mark INCONCLUSIVE; never silently substitute another tab, Space, document, or delivery target.

journeys.title: Load extension and verify popup connection
prerequisites: extension loaded unpacked in isolated profile
actions: Open extension action popup
wait for Loading pairing… to settle
record Space label, connection badge, selected visible HTTP(S) page and pending count
switch to atlas-space-b and reconnect
expectedVisibleStates: popup: Cockpit Space label and Connected badge
popup: page selector contains only fixture HTTP(S) tabs
popup: No pending capture or accurate pending count
popup: reconnect reports success or explicit error
failureStates: popup: Pairing unavailable/Disconnected
popup: no eligible HTTP(S) page
stale pairing candidate is not treated as connected

machineProof: tabs queried and selected tab id/url/document_id
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: reopen popup once; then capture service-worker console, pairing response and storage pairing record; INCONCLUSIVE if unresolved
retry once with gateway available; retain endpoint status and popup error text; INCONCLUSIVE, no fallback Space

journeys.cleanup: collector closes popup and owned disposable browser; preserve logs

journeys.title: Activate live-page palette and mode pass-through
actions: click Annotate page
inspect live page overlay controls
exercise Browse mode on a harmless page click, then Annotate mode
scroll, resize viewport, zoom, and move page layout; invoke Review
expectedVisibleStates: page overlay: fixed Cockpit annotation tools with Browse/Annotate selector
page overlay: Browse click reaches page and creates no mark
page overlay: geometry-dirty/review state is visible after movement
page overlay: Review permits capture only after alignment review or explicit capture-anyway
failureStates: overlay absent or controls intercept Browse click
overlay drifts, is clipped, or covers modal top layer
document changes without warning

machineProof: shadow DOM controls and mode value
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: toggle mode and repeat once; retain DOM/event trace and screenshot; INCONCLUSIVE if pass-through or overlay cannot be established
restore viewport and retry one movement; retain geometry diagnostics; INCONCLUSIVE if stale geometry is captured

journeys.cleanup: collector returns page to Browse mode

journeys.title: Create element, region, freehand and text annotations
actions: select Element tool and click button
select Region tool and drag rectangle
select Freehand tool and draw a bounded stroke
select + Text and place comment
save text inline beside freehand mark
expectedVisibleStates: page overlay: each mark has distinct visual geometry and tool identity
page overlay: text editor appears, accepts bounded comment and saves
page overlay: marks remain attached while scrolling within same document
failureStates: off-viewport or invalid geometry rejected with visible reason
pointer capture leaves a partial mark
text save fails but existing marks remain

screenshots: page overlay with three marks at 1440x900
page overlay with three marks at 1024x640
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: repeat only failed tool once on visible fixture target; retain serialized annotations and console; INCONCLUSIVE after second failure

screenshots: text editor and saved comment at 1440x900
text editor and saved comment at 1024x640
machineProof: draft storage record keyed by tab_id/document_id
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: reopen editor once; retain input/error and storage snapshot; INCONCLUSIVE without deleting marks

journeys.cleanup: collector owns and later removes all fixture marks

journeys.title: Edit and delete marks without retargeting
prerequisites: one annotation of every kind exists
actions: select element comment and edit text
edit freehand/text comment inline
remove region and one text mark
inspect remaining summary before capture
expectedVisibleStates: page overlay: edited content replaces old text
page overlay: removed marks disappear and remaining marks stay
popup: draft count/summary reflects only remaining annotations
failureStates: delete removes wrong mark
edit reattaches to another element
storage write error leaves misleading UI

evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: repeat failed operation once using same annotation ID; retain before/after storage and console; INCONCLUSIVE if identity changes

journeys.cleanup: collector removes all remaining annotations after capture journey

journeys.title: Capture visible page and save durable PNG
prerequisites: at least one remaining freehand and optional comment
actions: click Capture and save in popup or palette
observe capture progress and completion
read the saved PNG with image tooling
compare to page state
expectedVisibleStates: popup: saved/pending capture summary
captured image: page plus marks/comment; no palette/editor/+ Text/browser chrome
Cockpit rendering: pending browser feedback card when submitted/available
failureStates: pixel capture rejected due to document switch, size or timeout
PNG exceeds configured 4 MiB/6 MiB request limits
captured pixels are from another active tab

evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: retry once with unchanged selected tab; retain capture request, response and PNG diagnostics; INCONCLUSIVE if identity or contents mismatch
retry once after restoring visibility; retain storage and console; offer discard only explicitly

journeys.cleanup: collector retains PNG and metadata until retention journey, then deletes disposable artifacts

journeys.title: Detect stale draft after navigation or reload
prerequisites: unsaved marks and saved draft on fixture document
actions: close popup while edits exist
reload selected tab
navigate same tab to second fixture project and perform same-document URL change
reopen popup and inspect recovery
attempt capture and retry captured pixels after tab closure
expectedVisibleStates: popup: Saved drafts and Stale draft recovery identify old document
popup: stale summary offers inspect/discard, never silently attaches to new page
popup: failed submission retains captured pixels and explicit retry
failureStates: old marks appear on new document
duplicate URL is treated as same document
stale draft silently evicted at capacity

machineProof: draft records stale=true keyed by old identity
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: reload once more and compare identities; retain event timeline/storage; INCONCLUSIVE if no explicit recovery
one explicit Retry pending capture; retain network/receipt diagnostics and mark INCONCLUSIVE on unknown outcome

journeys.cleanup: collector discards stale drafts only after evidence is retained

journeys.title: Saved feedback, acknowledgement and retention
prerequisites: one or more saved captures pending in Cockpit
Cockpit feedback view available in atlas-space-a
actions: open Cockpit Browser feedback
verify pending cards and image rendering
acknowledge only first capture
refresh/reopen and verify newer capture remains pending
repeat acknowledgement and inspect image retention
expectedVisibleStates: Cockpit rendering: image card shows page/comment and pending state
Cockpit rendering: acknowledgement removes only selected pending card
Cockpit rendering: No pending browser annotations only when all are acknowledged
captured image remains readable during configured grace period
failureStates: acknowledgement removes wrong/newer ID
duplicate acknowledgement changes state
image disappears immediately or unknown receipt is pruned

evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: refresh once without refetch-destructive UI; retain response and image hashes; INCONCLUSIVE if IDs differ

machineProof: image file existence and retention timestamp
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: repeat same ack once; retain receipt and storage; INCONCLUSIVE if duplicate mutates another capture

journeys.cleanup: collector acknowledges or expires only disposable fixture captures and removes feedback records

journeys.title: Direct delivery to eligible and ineligible Cockpit targets
prerequisites: two Spaces with two tabs each where possible
active tab Luna pane eligible in atlas-space-a
ineligible target and wrong-Space target available
actions: select Send to agent from feedback overview with selected IDs
verify active-tab eligible target is selected without picker
attempt standalone send with no selected IDs
change active Space/destination during delivery
attempt explicit rejection and unknown dispatch outcome
expectedVisibleStates: Cockpit rendering: eligible target receives attachment and explicit delivery status
Cockpit rendering: no eligible target reports refusal, no fallback to another tab
Cockpit rendering: destination change is detected
popup/overview: rejected or unknown outcome retains capture and offers explicit retry
failureStates: paste is mistaken for submitted turn
wrong Space receives image
unknown outcome auto-pastes twice
ineligible target receives delivery

screenshots: Cockpit target and feedback overview at 1440x900
Cockpit target and feedback overview at 1024x640
evidenceMatrix.retryEscalation: retry once only after explicit failure and unchanged target; retain dispatch trace; INCONCLUSIVE if submission cannot be distinguished from paste
restore eligible target and retry once explicitly; retain target enumeration and error; never auto-route
one user-confirmed retry; retain receipt/network logs and mark INCONCLUSIVE if outcome remains unknown

journeys.cleanup: collector clears disposable delivery messages, closes owned panes/browser, and leaves protected/default sessions untouched

completionRule: All journey matrix cells have both viewport screenshots, machine proof and a recorded retry/escalation outcome. Any unavailable live behavior remains INCONCLUSIVE with diagnostics and is not inferred from static or historical evidence.
